control_plan.execution_strategy: Execute the project through the approved control baseline, control accounts, AWP packages and weekly decision cycle.
control_plan.control_strategy: Use schedule intake, data quality gates, WBS/CBS/activity mapping, EVM, AWP readiness, claims exposure and workflow approvals.
control_plan.progress_measurement_rule: Capture physical percent, quantities, labor hours and field evidence by control account each control period.
control_plan.cost_measurement_rule: Committed cost comes from contracts and purchase orders; incurred cost comes from payment certificates and warehouse receipts by control account before BAC, PV, EV, AC, CPI, EAC and VAC reporting.
control_plan.change_management_rule: Identify deviations, quantify cost/schedule impact, route approvals, update forecasts and preserve audit trail.
control_plan.risk_management_rule: Review schedule quality, productivity, cost variance, open constraints, procurement slippage, notices and claim exposure.
control_plan.procurement_strategy: Track RFQ packages, bid evaluation, purchase orders, warehouse receipts and contracting constraints that can affect workface readiness, critical path or contractual notices.
control_plan.document_control_rule: Link field reports, correspondence, notices, evidence, decisions and baseline artifacts to the controlled entity.
